# Contributing

# Contributing Guide

Welcome to the Cosmeron project!

Whether you're fixing a bug, improving existing features, or bringing new ideas to life, we're happy to have you contributing. This guide will help you get familiar with our coding standards, DSL conventions, and pull request process so we can build Cosmeron together.

Take a look around, explore the guidelines, and don't hesitate to get involved. Every contribution makes a difference!
Check the full information here: [Português](../Docs/pt/Governance/CONTRIBUTING.md) | [English](../Docs/en/Governance/CONTRIBUTING.md) | [Español](../Docs/es/Governance/CONTRIBUTING.md)
